newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egyptian pound averages 3.3903/3.3930 to dlr.
newsitem.headline: Egyptian pound averages 3.3903/3.3930 to dlr.

text.p: Private-sector Egyptian banks said the dollar ranged from 3.3860 to 3.3920 pounds bid and 3.3890 to 3.3960 offered in the interbank market on Tuesday.
A survey of five actively trading banks gave average rates of 3.3903 pounds bid and 3.3930 offered. The averages compared with 3.3889 bid and 3.3927 offered on Monday.
The Central Bank calculated the average exchange rate at midday as 3.388897 buy and 3.392382 sell.
